original_prompt: Write a Helm chart deploying a Java Spring Boot application with a separate config Secret (Spring profile), readiness and liveness probes targeting /actuator/health, and an Ingress with TLS.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a Java Spring Boot application with a separate config Secret (Spring profile), readiness and liveness probes targeting /actuator/health, and an Ingress with TLS.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: spring-boot-app
description: Production Helm chart for Spring Boot application
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "1.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 3
image:
  repository: registry.example.com/spring-boot-app
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  tag: "latest"
secret:
  name: spring-boot-config
  springProfilesActive: prod
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 8080
ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx
  host: app.example.com
  tlsSecretName: app-tls-secret
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 250m
    memory: 512Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 1000m
    memory: 1Gi
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "spring-boot-app.labels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ .Values.secret.name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "spring-boot-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
type: Opaque
stringData:
  SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE: {{ .Values.secret.springProfilesActive | quote }}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "spring-boot-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "spring-boot-app.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Values.secret.name }}
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health/liveness
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health/readiness
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "spring-boot-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type }}
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: 8080
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
---
# FILE: templates/ingress.yaml
{{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "spring-boot-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
spec:
  ingressClassName: {{ .Values.ingress.className }}
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - {{ .Values.ingress.host }}
      secretName: {{ .Values.ingress.tlsSecretName }}
  rules:
    - host: {{ .Values.ingress.host }}
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}
                port:
                  number: {{ .Values.service.port }}
{{- end }}
